ACSW ’252025pp. 40–47

Australasian Computer Science Week

Technical Framework to Ensure Data Subject’s Rights in GDPR: A Conceptual Design

Arwa Najdi, Rukshan Athauda, Herath Mudiyanselage Nelanga Dilum Bandara, and Suhuai Luo

The General Data Protection Regulation grants individuals rights over their personal data, while organisations face practical challenges in supporting those rights across modern data systems. This paper presents a conceptual technical framework to support data subject rights and GDPR compliance.

View on ACM Digital Library DOI: 10.1145/3727166.3727190
